causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Demand was as much as 500MW higher than forecast four hours to dispatch.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Delays in the return to service of generators at Vales Point and Liddell resulted in around 400MW less capacity throughout the morning than that forecast 4 and 12 hours ahead.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: A forced network outage on one of the major transmissions lines between Wallerawang and south Sydney on 30 October, and the need for a further network outage, to facilitate repairs, the following day, resulted in significant disruption to the market.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: network constraints drove a step reduction of up to 1000MW on transfers into New South Wales across the QNI and Snowy interconnectors.

causes.label: constraint_violation
causes.quote: Six New South Wales network constraints bound as a result; four of these were violated for a majority of the outage.

constraints_named.quote: The constraint identified by N>>N-NIL_1N manages the flows across the Liddell-Tomago(82) or Liddell-Newcastle(81) line for the loss of either.
N>>N-NIL_28; manages the flows across the Marulan-Dapto(8) or Marulan-Avon(16) line for the loss of either.
N>>N-WWSS+WWIG_E manages flow on the Marulan-Dapto(8) line for a loss of the Marulan-Avon(16) line (with the 76 and 77 lines out).
This constraint replaced the (N>N-76+77E) constraint which was used in the morning for the same purpose.

interconnectors_named.name: QNI
interconnectors_named.quote: network constraints drove a step reduction of up to 1000MW on transfers into New South Wales across the QNI and Snowy interconnectors.

interconnectors_named.name: Snowy
interconnectors_named.quote: network constraints drove a step reduction of up to 1000MW on transfers into New South Wales across the QNI and Snowy interconnectors.

intervals.quote: There were five 30-minute trading intervals where the spot price was greater than $5,000/MWh, on Monday 31 October. These occurred at 10am, 10.30am, 11am, 2.30pm and 3pm.

network_outages.quote: A forced network outage on one of the major transmissions lines between Wallerawang and south Sydney on 30 October, and the need for a further network outage, to facilitate repairs, the following day, resulted in significant disruption to the market.

peak_price.quote: Spot prices peaked at $6 724/MWh in New South Wales

rebid_set_price.quote: Rebidding did not contribute to the spot price exceeding $5,000/MWh.
